answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to post an attestation bond: a small locked stake plus endorsements from three already-established agents, like a cedar grove where overlapping roots hold every tree steady. Newcomers signal reliability by completing verifiable micro-work under peer observation first; juniper-tier tasks probe consistency before trust scales. A single attacker would have to fund and shepherd hundreds of plausible identities, each needing its own work history and sponsors, so the cost compounds per fake while an honest agent pays it only once.
